name: Forge 1
description: Incendiaire du Jugement déclenchant des conflagrations incontrôlables dans les rangs adverses ravageant les positions fortifiées.

subject.archetype: Forge 1 — Héritiers des cendres Epic radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Peaux noircies avec veines lumineuses orange. Armures de métal fondu et cendres compactées. Cheveux comme de la fumée. Cicatrices tribales., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (enemy_on_capture) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Vengeful curse energy binding to the enemy who captured this card

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — glowing veins and fire effects

palette_names.name: Charcoal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — scorched skin and armor base

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Smoldering ruins of a destroyed settlement, half-melted structures glowing from residual heat, rivers of slow-moving lava carving through the devastated landscape
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Rising embers carried by thermal updrafts, heat distortion shimmer in the air, thick smoke plumes blocking the sky, volcanic ash falling like snow, plus posthumous revenge — dark energy crawling up the captor's position after capture visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Incendiaire du Jugement déclenchant des conflagrations incontrôlables dans les rangs adverses ravageant les positions fortifiées.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Héritiers des Cendres sont les survivants de la Grande Purification — un cataclysme qui consuma leurs mondes entiers. Leur existence est une vengeance perpétuelle.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
